plan.objective: Verify current-source CL14 throughput after removing repeated full U-Net attention-processor map reconstruction from the disabled hard-case auxiliary path.
plan.single_scientific_change: None. The fix skips an auxiliary collector when its owning hard-case modes are disabled and caches the Diffusers processor map once when collectors are active.
plan.fixed_contract: CL14 model/data/loss/optimizer, batch 2, one A100, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240/219217920 trainable contract; one unchanged 12-image startup validation batch; 100 optimizer steps.
plan.primary_metric: Median displayed seconds/iteration over optimizer steps 21-100.
plan.decision_gate: Pass at no more than 2.30 seconds/iteration; otherwise profile the next bounded ex_ run.
plan.risk: Operational speed qualification only; no scientific quality claim.

runtime.pre_comet_failure: The first two submissions failed before Comet/training because the sealed runtime directory, then its source_manifest.json, was absent. Both deployment defects were corrected and the source was verified before retry.
